panels.description: In Bua-ji’s courtyard office, Bua-ji faces Saand while Duda perches above the desk. The recovered dhurrie and equipment fragment dominate the tabletop. Guddu is absent. Keep the upper third clear.
Duda repeats the goon’s phrase while Saand’s shoulder remains at the edge. Keep separate balloon spaces.
At the office doorway, Guddu begins to speak, then closes his mouth and lets Bua-ji judge. Leave the top third open.
Bua-ji removes the folded GODARAZ flyer from the cash box and tears the pending sale tab from the mustard ledger. Keep flyer, tab and ledger unobstructed.

items.speaker: SAAND
items.text: A piece of metal proves a piece of metal.

items.speaker: DUDA
items.text: “Big hall.” Bada hall. Same mouth. Different language.
